serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
What?! {{wi}}It's the police! Why now?!
Policewoman: Good afternoon citizen! 
You: Good afternoon… What brings you here officer? 
There are two of them.  The one that greeted me is a pretty tall woman. She looks like she means business. The second one reminds me of a stereotypical mall cop character from movies. He’s short, white and chubby.
Policewoman: You can relax sir. We only came to ask some questions. For now at least… 
You: And what kind of question are you going to ask?
Policeman: Stop asking us. We are here to ask, so listen to our questions and reply only when… {{wi}}uh… {{wi}}you are asked!
You: A-alright.
Policewoman: As I was saying… We came here just for a periodic assessment of local hate crimes. 
Policewoman: Sir, have you been a witness of a religion, sexual orientation or race based hate crime? As written in the Criminal Code of the USA, hate crime is…
Policeman: Have you heard anybody shouting homophobic slurs or something like that in the area? 
Policewoman: I’m not done explaining what hate…
Policeman: He knows what it is! Hey kid, have you been watching the news lately? 
You: I think so, yeah.
Policeman: See? Let’s get it over with fast. I’m getting hungry.
Policewoman: ...Alright then.
Policewoman: So… Any hate crimes in the area? 
You: I don’t think so… 
Policewoman: Well, that would be all. Thank you for your cooperation. 
You: No problem, bye.
